text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Six bandits are gunned down by security forces on Christmas day in Samburu district after five others and a tourist are killed in neighbouring Marsabit.
- More than 100 tourists are stranded at an incomplete hotel on the coast.
- Some 1,000 people are homeless after fire sweeps through a slum area of Nairobi.
- Angry mourners force Kenya's health minister to leave a funeral service in a clash over an opposition leader's bid for the presidency of his party.
- Sugercane worth thousands of shillings is rotting at Kano in Kisumu district because of a lack of harvesting marchinery.
- Nyanza's provincial commissioner instructs immigration officials on the Kenya-Tanzania border not to allow Rwandan refugees into the country.
- President Daniel arap Moi announces the posts of district chairmen in the ruling Kenya African National Union party will be replaced by sub-branch chairmen. ($1=55 Kenyan shillings)
